items.title: Azure infrastructure provisioning
items.body: Provision Azure resources using Bicep: Static Web App (Free tier), Cosmos DB Serverless, Storage Standard LRS, Container Apps (Consumption).

items.title: FastAPI skeleton + health endpoint
items.body: Create the FastAPI app entry point with CORS configuration and a GET /api/health endpoint that checks connectivity to all Azure services.

items.title: CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)
items.body: Implement GitHub Actions workflow: test → infra provision → Docker build/push to ACR → deploy Container App → deploy Static Web App.

iterations.name: Core AI & Storage
iterations.goal: Users can chat with AI and upload files

items.title: AI Chat endpoint – Azure OpenAI /api/chat
items.body: Implement POST /api/chat using Azure OpenAI gpt-4o-mini. Accept a messages array, max_tokens, and temperature. Return the assistant reply.

items.title: Conversation persistence – Cosmos DB /api/chat/history
items.body: Save each chat turn to Cosmos DB keyed by user ID. Implement GET /api/chat/history to return conversation history.

items.title: File upload – Azure Blob Storage /api/storage/upload
items.body: Implement POST /api/storage/upload (multipart, max 10 MB). Store file in Azure Blob Storage. Return file_name, url, size. Also expose GET /api/storage/sas for time-limited SAS URLs.

items.title: Frontend UI – Chat + file upload (Static Web App)
items.body: Build vanilla JS frontend hosted on Azure Static Web App. Include chat message list, input box, send button, and file upload control that calls the API.

items.title: Security: Upgrade python-multipart CVE fix (0.0.9 → 0.0.22)
items.body: Bump python-multipart from 0.0.9 to 0.0.22 to patch two CVEs: arbitrary file write via path traversal and DoS via malformed multipart boundary.

items.title: SWA built-in auth (AAD / GitHub provider)
items.body: Configure Azure Static Web App built-in authentication with AAD and GitHub identity providers. Add login/logout routes and protect the frontend.

items.title: Bind chat history and uploads to authenticated user ID
items.body: Extract the authenticated user ID from the SWA client principal header and use it as the partition key for Cosmos DB documents and blob path prefix.

items.title: API authorisation middleware (validate SWA client principal)
items.body: Add FastAPI middleware that reads the x-ms-client-principal header, decodes the base64 JSON, and rejects unauthenticated requests with 401.

items.title: Expense categorisation endpoint /api/expenses/categorise
items.body: Implement POST /api/expenses/categorise. Accept a list of transaction descriptions and amounts. Use Azure OpenAI to classify each into a spending category (Food, Transport, etc.).

items.title: Transaction ingestion – CSV / bank statement upload parser
items.body: Extend the file upload flow to detect CSV uploads and parse them as transaction records (date, description, amount). Store parsed rows in Cosmos DB.

items.title: Expense storage schema in Cosmos DB
items.body: Define the Cosmos DB document schema for expense records: id, userId, date, description, amount, currency, category, source. Create indexes for userId + date queries.

items.title: Expense list / filter API /api/expenses
items.body: Implement GET /api/expenses with optional query params: from_date, to_date, category, limit. Returns paginated expense records for the authenticated user.

iterations.name: Budgeting
iterations.goal: Users set budgets and track progress

items.title: Budget CRUD API /api/budgets
items.body: Implement POST, GET, PUT, DELETE /api/budgets. Each budget has a category, monthly_limit, currency, and is scoped to the authenticated user.

items.title: Budget vs. actual calculation service
items.body: Add a service that, given a user and a month, aggregates expenses by category and compares against budget limits. Expose via GET /api/budgets/summary?month=YYYY-MM.

items.title: Spending dashboard – Chart.js (budget vs. actual)
items.body: Add a dashboard page to the frontend showing bar/doughnut charts of budget vs. actual spending per category using Chart.js, fed by /api/budgets/summary.

items.title: Budget alert notifications (email/push on threshold breach)
items.body: Send a notification (email via Azure Communication Services or browser push) when a category spending reaches 80% or 100% of the monthly budget limit.

items.title: AI-powered savings recommendations via chat
items.body: Extend the chat system prompt with the user's spending summary so the AI can proactively suggest savings strategies based on actual expense patterns.

items.title: Monthly summary report (PDF export)
items.body: Generate a monthly PDF report summarising income, expenses by category, and budget adherence. Expose via GET /api/reports/monthly?month=YYYY-MM.

items.title: Mobile-responsive UI improvements
items.body: Audit and improve the frontend for mobile viewports: responsive grid, touch-friendly controls, readable font sizes on small screens.

items.title: Performance tuning + load testing
items.body: Run k6 or Locust load tests against the API. Identify and resolve bottlenecks. Target p95 < 500 ms for chat and < 200 ms for expense list under 50 concurrent users.
